services.name: Fishing Derbies
services.desc: A free event for anglers of all ages from 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. Trophies and prizes will be awarded to both adults and youth. A door prize drawing will be held for all registered youth participants. Visit the Fishing Derby event page for more

gap: Price for boat rentals not stated
blurb: Guests can rent pedal boats, rowboats, or water trikes on a first come, first served basis during peak season. The Boathouse also offers food including personal pizzas, Italian hoagies, hamburgers, and snacks. Fishing supplies including live bait and tackle items are available for purchase.
extraNote: Boat rentals are first come, first served; no reservations needed · All boat rentals must be returned at closing time · Hours and days of operation are subject to change and weather permitting
